_note: Our story, in order. Each entry: year, title, text. Add the historian's finds here.

entries.title: Bucket brigades
entries.text: Before there was a department, neighbors fought fires the only way they could: a line of people passing buckets.

entries.title: September 24: neighbors organize
entries.text: On September 24, 1934, Bethany residents held the organizational meeting that created the department. They met in a donated schoolhouse, the Center School.

entries.title: The first truck
entries.text: A 1935 Ford became the department's first fire truck.

entries.title: A Seagrave pumper
entries.text: The department added a 1942 Seagrave pumper.

entries.title: Center Station
entries.text: Center Station, on Amity Road, opened.

entries.title: Hinman Station
entries.text: Hinman Station opened on Bear Hill Road.

entries.title: Headquarters
entries.text: Headquarters at 765 Amity Road opened. It is where we meet every Tuesday night.
